messages.subject: R equivalent of MCDS.exe
parts:
Hi,

Right now I'm calling MCDS.exe from an R program. However, I would like to not depend on the MCDS.exe, because I have to more the project to a linux server.
 
Is there an R equivalent to MCDS.exe? 

Right now, here is how I'm using MCDS.exe from the R program:

# code to generate input_.tmp   
# ...
cmd <- paste(shQuote(file.path("C:/Program Files (x86)/Distance 6", "MCDS")), " 0, ", 
                    shQuote(file.path(path, "input_.tmp")), sep = "")
      
system(cmd, wait = TRUE, ignore.stdout = FALSE, ignore.stderr = FALSE, 
             invisible = TRUE)


Thank

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] R equivalent of MCDS.exe
parts:
Hi Addame,

There are a couple of R packages that provide the same functionality as
MCDS.exe. The easiest to start with is called Distance, you can install
it from CRAN using

install.packages("Distance")

in R. Eric Rexstad has prepared a couple of examples of using the
Distance package that might help you get started:

http://distancesampling.org/R/vignettes/ducknests.html

http://distancesampling.org/R/vignettes/minke.html


I hope this helps!

cheers,
--dave
